User: The local origin is the right one. And should actually be master. Force push. [...] Assistant: Confirmed: GitHub's default branch is currently `stuff-page-redesign`, no `master` exists yet. I'll rename the local branch to `master`, force-push it to origin, and set it as the repo's default branch.

Assistant: `master` is now pushed to origin. Now let's set it as the default branch on GitHub.

Assistant: Done — `master` is now the default branch on GitHub with our content, `stuff-page-redesign` (old, unrelated history) left untouched on origin in case you want it for reference, and local tracks `origin/master` going forward.
